weather_report:
As the dark stretch of night slowly yields to dawn, Boston lies enveloped in a blanketing fog, its charm softened by the whisper of rain beginning to fall. The prospect of capricious thunderstorms adds a hint of urgency to the air; the clouds loom heavy with the promise of a wild summer storm. The world outside, draped in the shadows of early morning, suggests a delicate balance between serenity and turmoil, inviting contemplations reserved for cozy cafes or a quiet nook in a well-loved bookshop.

As the day unfolds, expect the dance of fog and rain to continue, with temperatures creeping toward a mild warmth, bringing with it the faint promise of sunbreaks shyly peeking through the gloom. The winds will rattle the leaves, ushering in an energetic breeze that contrasts with the stillness around you. A light layering of clothing seems prudent; a breathable rain jacket and well-worn boots will provide comfort and practicality as you navigate both puddles and possibility. This might be a day to explore the hidden galleries of local artists, sip coffee infused with the scent of freshly baked pastries, or lose yourself in the pages of an enchanting novel at a sidewalk café—all while the city awakens amidst the rhythmic fall of raindrops.
